Class CockroachDBTransactionTemplate

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.transaction.support.DefaultTransactionDefinition
org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionTemplate
com.cockroachlabs.data.template.CockroachDBTransactionTemplate
All Implemented Interfaces:
CockroachDBTransactionOperations, Serializable, org.springframework.beans.factory.InitializingBean, org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionOperations, org.springframework.transaction.TransactionDefinition
public class CockroachDBTransactionTemplate extends org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionTemplate implements CockroachDBTransactionOperations
A TransactionTemplate that retries the whole callback, in a fresh transaction each time, when CockroachDB reports a serialization conflict (SQLSTATE 40001).

Use it exactly like TransactionTemplate: configure it with the inherited setters (DefaultTransactionDefinition.setIsolationLevel(int), DefaultTransactionDefinition.setReadOnly(boolean), DefaultTransactionDefinition.setTimeout(int), ...) and call execute(TransactionCallback) or TransactionOperations.executeWithoutResult(Consumer). Its operations are declared by CockroachDBTransactionOperations, which extends TransactionOperations, the same way TransactionTemplate's are declared by TransactionOperations. On top of TransactionTemplate it adds:

  • retry settings (setMaxRetries(int), setDelay(long), setMultiplier(double), setMaxDelay(long)), which default to the cockroachdb.retry.* properties;
  • a session region (setRegion(String), or the inRegion(String) shortcut) for REGIONAL BY ROW tables, which defaults to RegionContext, the RegionResolver, then cockroachdb.region.default-region;
  • Supplier and Runnable overloads for callbacks that don't need the TransactionStatus, inherited from CockroachDBTransactionOperations.
Unlike TransactionTemplate, the isolation level defaults to SERIALIZABLE.

Like @CockroachDBTransactional, it retries only when it starts the transaction. Called inside a transaction that is already running, it runs the callback once and leaves retrying to whoever owns that transaction.

As with TransactionTemplate, configure an instance before sharing it between threads. To vary settings, copy the shared instance with CockroachDBTransactionTemplate(CockroachDBTransactionTemplate) and configure the copy.

    • setRegion

      public void setRegion(String region)
      Run SET crdb_region to this region at the start of each transaction, overriding RegionContext, the RegionResolver and the default region. null or blank restores that resolution chain.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the region is malformed or not in cockroachdb.region.allowed (when validation is on)

    • execute

      public <T> T execute(org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionCallback<T> action) throws org.springframework.transaction.TransactionException
      Runs action in a transaction, as TransactionTemplate.execute(TransactionCallback) does, and retries it in a fresh transaction when it fails with SQLSTATE 40001 anywhere in the cause chain, whatever exception type wraps it. Any other exception is rethrown immediately. Inside a transaction that is already running, it runs once.
